name: DeepFluoro (Grupp et al., IPCAI 2020): the H5 release and the vendor DICOMs

pairing.region: pelvis, hip and lower lumbar spine
pairing.xray: 366 frames with registered poses (H5), and 2,659 vendor frames
pairing.ct: 6 CTs with the H5 set, one per specimen, and 19 CT files in the vendor deposit
pairing.masks: 7 classes in 3D and per frame in 2D; the vertebrae are one class, with the upper sacrum
pairing.annotate: split the vertebrae class into named lumbar bodies

what: 6 cadaver specimens from pelvic osteotomy experiments: 366 fluoroscopy frames with registered poses and 3D and 2D labels in one H5 file (doi:10.7281/T1/IFSXNV), and the vendor DICOM deposit of the same experiments, 2,659 frames and 19 CT files (doi:10.7281/T1/C304HZ)
level_truth: pelvis and lower lumbar spine, from the CT
licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 by the H5 release's LICENSE, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 by its datasheet: non-commercial either way
how_to_get: Held: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/deepfluoro_h5; /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/deepfluoro_vendor, fetched from the JHU Dataverse on 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-22; nothing to fetch.
To share it with collaborators, copy it into /rs/rs_grp_oschome/shared/datasets/deepfluoro/ with its checksums as a Slurm job, as the pig set of #22 was copied, and note the job in the history.
source_status: held on the grid under the owner's data root, as SchwingNet's registry records it on 2026-10-23

history.note: on the grid at /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/deepfluoro_h5; /rs/rs_grp_oschome/go2432/data/deepfluoro_vendor, fetched from the JHU Dataverse on 2026-09-20 and 2026-09-22, before the shared tree and its promoter existed; the record written for the census (#178) from SchwingNet's registry
